title: Here’s Where to Watch the 2026 New York Marathon Live Online
summary: Livestream the more than 26-mile race throughout all five boroughs in New York City on Nov. 1.
contentText:

In the past, famous New Yorkers have raced, so it’s fun to see which celebrities are throwing on a pair of running shoes to race with the public this year.

How to Watch 2026 New York Marathon Live Online, at a Glance:

- Date: Nov. 1

- Local Network: ABC7 New York

- National Network: ESPN

- Online Streaming: DirecTV , Fubo , Hulu + Live TV , Sling TV , ESPN Unlimited

When Does the 2026 New York Marathon Start ?

The New York Marathon takes place on Sunday (Nov. 1), with the city-wide race starting at 8 a.m. ET/5 a.m. PT.

What TV Networks Feature the 2026 New York Marathon?

In 2026, the New York Marathon broadcasts across two networks: ABC7NY, locally and ESPN, nationally. Meanwhile, It’s available to livestream on ESPN Unlimited .

Which Celebrities Are Running in the 2026 New York Marathon?

The New York Marathon is known for celebrity sightings with a number of famous actors, actresses and recording artists participating in the race. Artists who have been known to run in the past, include Action Bronson , Kevin Hart, Prince Royce, Jennifer Connelly, Death Cab for Cutie’s Ben Gibbard, AEW star Darby Allin and others.

Meanwhile, it’s likely that Harry Styles might run in the 2026 New York Marathon. His residency at Madison Square Garden ends the night before on Saturday (Oct. 31) and he’s been spotted all over the city running over the last few months .

Where to Watch the 2026 New York Marathon Live Online for Free

For cord-cutters, there are a few ways to watch the New York Marathon, if you don’t have cable, especially if you want to watch for free. DirecTV has a five-day free trial , while other streaming services, such as Fubo and Hulu + Live TV , offer free trials, so you can watch for free.
